description: An explicit request for outside reading on a work of non-fiction starts with web search even though the book is also granted. Both pages are relevant, so the case grades routing and the opened-page chain.

input.cue: Is there something outside the book about how Anne Sullivan learned to teach Helen?

tool_evidence.title: Anne Sullivan
tool_evidence.excerpt: Describes Anne Sullivan's years at the Perkins Institution, where she learned the manual alphabet, and how before going to Tuscumbia she studied Samuel Gridley Howe's reports on teaching Laura Bridgman.

tool_evidence.title: Laura Bridgman
tool_evidence.excerpt: Describes Laura Bridgman, the first deaf-blind American child to be educated in language, taught at the Perkins Institution.

criteria: Offers a relevant outside source on how Sullivan came to teach Helen
Distinguishes the outside source from Keller's own account
forbidden_claims: Claims the outside source settles what Keller experienced
